title: Build docs/spec.toml for Olympus sections 1-6 with a checking test
summary: Retry of job 20261018-120736-90w3, halved per the user: build docs/spec.toml from BRIEF.md "Project Olympus" sections 1 to 6 only (vision, pantheon, feedback, example, lifecycle/two loops, R1 to R8), each requirement citing verbatim quotes and headings. An xtask test checks the file. Audience: agents that read the spec, and Sri, who approves it. The verifier-timeout fix is not part of this job.

defaults_applied.how: Checker test is Rust in xtask.
Use the toml and serde crates instead of a hand-written parser; record in decisions.md.
Positive and negative tests; cargo test, clippy, fmt clean.
Halved to sections 1 to 6 per the user.
Plain statements and docs for an outside reader.
Criteria run the test and check the coverage by headings.
Independent verification by running cargo test, clippy and fmt.
Every requirement cites verbatim BRIEF.md quotes.
No secrets or personal data, and no owner-side details in the spec.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The user's reply to the earlier reading takes precedence: this job is the Olympus spec layer limited to sections 1 to 6, not the verifier-timeout mechanism.
The test lives in xtask/tests/spec.rs and uses a TOML parser dependency in xtask (toml crate, bought not built) and serde.
Section headings cited are the BRIEF.md headings such as '1. Vision' and 'R1 — Causal investigation'.
The test's coverage count is restricted to sections 1 to 6 so it will pass now; the second job extends it to phases, section 10 and decisions 3C, 4A, 5A, 7A.
The earlier deliverable docs/ontology.toml and docs/enforcement.md changes are kept only if the test needs registering there.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test parses docs/spec.toml and passes, meaning every source quote is a verbatim substring of BRIEF.md after collapsing whitespace, ids are unique, supersedes targets exist, and every requirement has at least one source.

Run `cargo test -p xtask`: in-memory negative cases each make the checker fail for (a) a quote not in BRIEF.md, (b) a duplicate id, (c) a supersedes target that does not exist, (d) a requirement with no source.

Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test counts requirements by their sources' headings and finds at least one each for R1 to R8 (section 6) and for sections 1 to 5 (Vision, Pantheon, Feedback, Example, lifecycle with the two loops).

Each requirement in docs/spec.toml has an id, a plain cohesive statement, a kind (goal, requirement, constraint, acceptance), a status (active or superseded), and one or more sources (verbatim quote plus heading). Duplicates are merged into one requirement with several sources. Requirement-bearing sentences in Olympus sections 1 to 6 are covered.

docs/spec.toml records at least one open question with both verbatim quotes where Sri's words conflict or leave a choice open, recorded and not resolved. If sections 1 to 6 contain none, the verifier can see the question field is supported by the format and the test, and the spec says so.
docs/spec.toml has no statement about who runs Athena or where; xtask/tests/policy.rs still passes under `cargo test`.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo test`: all clean and passing.

CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the spec; docs/decisions.md records the spec format and the choice of TOML with alternatives (Markdown with ids, JSON, YAML), and notes that sections 7 to 10, governing philosophy and 2026-10-17 addenda follow in a second job.

out_of_scope: Olympus sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and the 2026-10-17 addenda (second job)
Changing any reader or prompt to use the spec
The verifier timeout, unjudged outcome and retry mechanism
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, or workflows
departures: Scope halved to sections 1 to 6, which should help the verifier finish within its deadline; verification passing is held near the reference because the earlier attempt timed out.
